confirmed_bugs.problem: heading_error = 0.0 evaluates to (0.0 or math.pi) = math.pi. Perfect heading match receives ZERO heading bonus (0.10 * max(0, 1 - pi/pi) = 0) instead of maximum bonus (0.10 * max(0, 1 - 0/pi) = 0.10).
confirmed_bugs.fix: Change to `heading_error if heading_error is not None else 0.0`

confirmed_bugs.problem: Ambiguity check uses `best[1] - scored[1][1] < ambiguity_margin_m` but best[1] <= scored[1][1] always, so difference <= 0 < margin always true. Should be `scored[1][1] - best[1] < ambiguity_margin_m`.
confirmed_bugs.fix: Swap to `scored[1][1] - best[1]` and rename variables for clarity

confirmed_bugs.problem: Architecture assumes 1 OSM way -> 1 XODR road. Does not support one-to-many (OSM way split into multiple XODR roads) or many-to-one. No source interval/orientation tracking.
confirmed_bugs.fix: Introduce typed association with osm_way_id, xodr_road_id, source fraction interval, target s interval, orientation, class, confidence, evidence

confirmed_bugs.problem: Score based mainly on distance, heading, name. Missing: symmetric geometric distance, centerline overlap, endpoint proximity, length/extent ratio, street name, highway class, oneway, lane count, junction neighborhood, network topology.
confirmed_bugs.fix: Add evidence terms incrementally with labeled fixtures and calibration

confirmed_bugs.problem: Road samples alone populate grid buckets. Long/curved segments can be missed. Need conservative segment AABBs or STRtree/R-tree.
confirmed_bugs.fix: Use segment AABBs or STRtree for candidate discovery
